They referred us to a behavioral therapist. They didn’t us anymore advice than what we were already doing
His first response to any frustration is to start swinging. I’ve tried boundaries, redirecting, taking away favorite activities, time out. I’m at my wits end.
I remove his sister or the dog or myself when he starts swinging and tell him my job is to keep them safe and if he’s going to hit them I need to remove them.
They just keep telling me to redirect.
other times she cries the whole time and I have to leave the room to save myself from taking out my frustration on her.
While this seems to be working I can't help but feel like I'm abandoning her when she needs me.
